g.text: Task by task: Persian and everyone else
ParsBERT; Matina corpus (73B tokens) and LLM;
Others: no monolingual model; XLM-R, Glot500
APARSIN: first beyond the top five varieties
no natively written QA for any other variety
DeepMine (480+ h ASR), ParsVoice (3,526 h TTS)
Sorani: JIRA, CORDI. DOLMA: 40+ h for six varieties
For most varieties, the first dataset of any kind is still to be built.
